property_summary: For any admissible inputs where transfer completes (does not revert), the reference C.transfer(...) returns true; the mutant returns false for those same non-reverting inputs, so the property is that a non-reverting call to transfer always returns true (which the mutant breaks for some inputs).
change_summary: Change the returned boolean from true to false at end of transfer so successful (non-reverting) calls return false instead of true.
